question: 20 women can complete a work in 15 days. 16 men can complete the same work in 15 days. Find the ratio between the work efficiency of a men to a women.
solution:
**Given:**

20 women can complete a work in 15 days.

16 men can complete the same work in 15 days.

**Formula used:**

Work Efficiency Ratio = Total Work Done / Total Time Taken

**Calculation:**

Total Work by 20 women in 1 day = Total Work / Time = 20 × 1

Total Work by 16 men in 1 day = Total Work / Time = 16 × 1 

Efficiency of 1 woman = Total Work by 20 women in 1 day ÷ 20 = 1 ÷ 15 ÷ 20 = 1 ÷ (15 × 20)

Efficiency of 1 man = Total Work by 16 men in 1 day ÷ 16 = 1 ÷ 15 ÷ 16 = 1 ÷ (15 × 16)

Ratio of Efficiency of Man to Woman:

⇒ (1 ÷ (15 × 16)) ÷ (1 ÷ (15 × 20))

⇒ (15 × 20) ÷ (15 × 16)

⇒ 5 ÷ 4

**∴ The correct answer is option 1 (5 : 4).**
